events.factual_description: KEYSTONE CLUB TOKYO presents Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Trio+1 on Tuesday, November 24, 2026. Doors are at 18:30 and the performance starts at 19:30. The current primary page lists Tsuyoshi Yamamoto on piano, Hiroshi Kagawa on bass and Toshio Osumi on drums. Although the event title retains '+1,' no fourth musician is identified and none is inferred. The performance charge is ¥3,800; the venue separately lists table charges of ¥550 for normal seating and ¥1,100 for VIP seating. The event page contains an active reservation form.

en.why_it_matters: The page now confirms Yamamoto with Hiroshi Kagawa and Toshio Osumi, the rhythm partners who let his touch, blues phrasing and control of space register as a real trio language rather than a name on an unfinished listing. In a small Roppongi room, that established conversation is the reason to go.
en.trip_verdict: If November 24 overlaps a Tokyo stay, actively make room for the trio at Keystone. It is a strong anchor for the evening, but another Yamamoto club date one week earlier means this concert alone does not justify rerouting the wider trip.

es.why_it_matters: La ficha ya confirma a Yamamoto con Hiroshi Kagawa y Toshio Osumi, la sección que convierte su toque, su fraseo de blues y su manejo del espacio en un verdadero lenguaje de trío, no sólo en un nombre dentro de un anuncio incompleto. En una sala pequeña de Roppongi, esa conversación establecida es la razón concreta para ir.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 24 de noviembre coincide con una estancia en Tokio, le haría espacio activamente al trío en Keystone. Puede anclar muy bien la noche, pero otra fecha de Yamamoto en el mismo club una semana antes hace innecesario desviar por sí sola el itinerario completo.
